title: Merry Pugmas Large Mug~Pug Dog w/Scarf~Red Background~Christmas Holiday Ceramic
descriptionText:
This large mug features a cute and cuddly pug dog named "Merry Pugmas" with a scarf around its neck. The mug has a red background and is perfect for any pug dog lover. It is made of high-quality materials and is perfect for collectibles.

The mug is perfect for dog lovers who enjoy collecting unique items. It is handmade with care and attention to detail. This item is a must-have for anyone who loves pug dogs and wants to add a cute and charming addition to their collection.
